verdict.rationale: SerpApi is itself a programmatic HTTP API with API-key auth, official client libraries, and an async submit-and-retrieve-later mode, so non-interactive, headless automation is a native, documented capability. A community commenter confirms it is widely used from scripts and AI tools. However, the evidence never documents CI-specific usage, so coverage of the story as written is incomplete. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions or env-var secret handling for the REST API), and hands-on corroboration of running it in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
